lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Didn't you die?

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Almost. I managed to survive by shrinking myself down to an extreme degree.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Back from the dead, as they say.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Do you think I could defeat you right now?

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I doubt so.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Why are you here?

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: That thing you fired at me...

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I'm going to use it myself.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Do you intend to fire it at the Ark?

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Then what will you do?

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Stop stalling time, mere human.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Otherwise, you die.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: The controls seem simple enough.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: No separate authentication process required, it seems.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Probably so everyone can use it in an emergency.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: A good decision for those who chose isolation.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I'll use this for a moment.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: How much output did you use when you fired it at me?

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Lies.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: You see, I possess a skill, mere human.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: A technique that scrambles the brain.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I can extract the information I want, but your brain will be physically destroyed.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Shall I do it?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: There's no reason for you not to do that.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: It'd be a waste of time and effort.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: And...

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: it's also my way of thanking you for creating this.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: ... Excuse me?

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Answer my question.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: ... About 30%.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Yes, that ought to be enough.
Liberalio begins to operate Eden's Spear control panel with her tentacles.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Your technology is such a hassle.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I never imagined you'd have a facility this large.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: A technology beyond anything I've known. Most impressive.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: ... Why have you come here?

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: To find Nihilister.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: It wouldn't matter if she died, but she tends to blurt out anything when she's in danger.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I was searching the surrounding area to silence her.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: But the sound of the rain here was a bit different.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I figured she must be trapped somewhere undetectable,

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: like in the Atlas Cage.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: But now, it seems she's been released.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: You don't appear to have much of a sense of camaraderie.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Not for me, at least. I only have love.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I was on my way to find Nihilister when you attacked.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: That's when I found the very thing that I've been in search of for so long.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I no longer care what happens to Nihilister.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Searching... are you talking about Eden's Spear?

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: ... Done.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Pressing this should make it fire.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Ugh...!
Cecil lunges at Liberalio.
Liberalio flicks her tentacle to knock Cecil back, and she immediately loses consciousness.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: You charge in even though you know you have no chance. That's why I like you.
Liberalio's tentacle reaches for a crudely shaped button.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I'll see you soon,

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Mother.
*Press*
That day, the second pillar of light bursts forth from Eden,
tearing through the clouds
and reaching the very ends of the sky,
as if a beacon
heralding a new era.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Why is that? To be dazed all of a sudden... how extraordinary!

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Chime.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Over there.
Chime looks where Marian is pointing.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Prithee, there's something yonder?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Please look between the mountains that look like a bosom.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: What a metaphor that is!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Hmm... Eh?!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: What is that light, pray tell?

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: 'Tis far too large to be mere fireworks...

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Seems a beam, methinks.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Oh.
Marian jerks her head up and looks at the sky.
Chime watches her uneasily.
In Marian's eyes, a strange glow flickers, unlike anything seen before.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Chime. I...

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I feel it.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: That presence...

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Ohhh... I see. She's coming.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: What's gotten into thee all of a sudden? Hast thou eaten something wrong?

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: How many times must I tell thee—don't go picking up those nasty bugs from the floor! Eat something proper, I say!

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Chime.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Ah, stop calling my name already! 'Twill wear out if thou keep'st it up!

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I think I need to go.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Go? And where pray tell?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: If I stay here, all will be lost.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I can't let that happen.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: The world she and I envision is different.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: So I must go.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I must go and take it back.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: ... What in the world art thou babbling about?

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Are ye okay?
Chime stands on her tiptoes and places her hand on Marian's forehead.
Marian takes Chime's hand and brings it to her cheek.
With a faint smile, she nuzzles her face into Chime's palm.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: H-hey! What are thee doing? How shameless of thee!

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Chime.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Thank you,

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Crown, Kilo, T.A.L.O.S., and everyone.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Thank you so much for everything you've done for me.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I love you.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: *Gasp!*

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Siren, what's the matter?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: No... don't...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Siren, are you okay?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Look at me. Let me see your face.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Cinder... ella...!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Yes, I'm right here.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: What is it? Has something happened?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Are you unwell?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: This is... bad.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: What's the matter?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: The veil of bubbles that once... hid the Queen's eyes...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... has shattered.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Now... the Queen's eyes shall see all.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: With the veil gone, the Queen...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: will... descend.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: The Queen...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: will descend.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: ... What happened?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... Eden's Spear was fired into the sky, and Liberalio vanished.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: She said she has a mountain of matters to resolve and no time to deal with us.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Before it arrives, she said, the place must be thoroughly cleaned up.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: ... And just what is that supposed to mean?

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: ... I know not.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Aside from that, no other issues?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: For instance, Eden's status or any casualties?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Nothing, except a minor communications disruption.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: *Sigh*... So she really just fired Eden's Spear and left.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I have no idea what she was thinking.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Cecil.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Listen carefully.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: After Liberalio fired Eden's Spear into the sky,

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: we can now detect something we couldn't before.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Something that was previously blocked and could not be observed is now visible.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: The Queen...?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Yes, the Queen has been detected. And...

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: she's adjusted her trajectory

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: and is currently descending to the surface.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Hurry. Prepare Eden's Spear again.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: ... Roger that.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: I shall summon the Forerunner maidens.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: The Pioneers? Will they come?

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Verily, I summoned them forth upon discovering Fire Dragon. The matter at hand seemed most peculiar, so it proved wise to call them early.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Time it may take, yet arrive they shall.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... Very well.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I'll leave that to you.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Verily, I shall see it done.
Nayuta finds a soft patch of grass on the plains and sits cross-legged,
gazing up at the sky.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: I ponder... Is it too soon, or just in time?

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Were it within the bounds of possibility, I would have much preferred additional preparation.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Yet, as with all things, naught proceeds according to one's designs.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: As ever, we may do naught but our best.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Prithee, make haste and come, all of you.
Nayuta's wheel begins to spin.
Soon after,
a golden pillar of light shoots up from Nayuta's body into the sky.
EDEN SPEAR: END
